why: Searches surfaced only work on variants/related statements (Vojta's abc conjecture for toric varieties and algebraic tori, GCD inequalities 'inspired by' the conjecture, a K-stability connection for a specific divisor on toric Fano varieties, and a 2025 reorganization of Vojta's older Mordell conjecture proof) — none proving a case, bound, or resolution of the general height inequality conjecture as stated; a general search confirms it remains open.
queries: Vojta's conjecture general case height inequality algebraic number fields open problem status

found.title: On Vojta's proof of the Mordell conjecture
found.note: Reorganizes Vojta's 1991 proof of the Mordell (Faltings) theorem using Arakelov geometry; not a result on Vojta's general height conjecture.

found.title: Vojta's abc conjecture for entire curves in toric varieties highly ramified over the boundary
found.note: Proves a variant (Vojta's abc conjecture, complex/Nevanlinna analogue) for a restricted class of toric varieties.

found.title: Vojta's abc conjecture for algebraic tori and applications over function fields
found.note: Function-field variant result, distinct statement from the number-field height conjecture.

found.title: GCD inequalities inspired by Vojta's conjecture
found.note: GCD inequalities in the spirit of the conjecture, not a proof of a case of it.

found.title: Connections between K-stability and Vojta's conjecture
found.note: Shows existence of a torus-invariant divisor on toric Fano varieties for which the conjecture holds; narrow special case, pre/around-snapshot dated.
